text: Core Focus: Using one or more foreign languages such as English, French, German, Japanese, etc. as the medium, this research examines the structure (phonetics, vocabulary, grammar, discourse) and functions (the role of language in society and culture) of languages, as well as their applications (how to effectively teach, learn, and use language).Research Scope:Theoretical Level: Covers phonology, lexicology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, psycholinguistics, etc., exploring the inherent laws of language and the essence of human language capabilities.Applied Level: Focuses on second language acquisition (patterns for foreigners learning Chinese and Chinese people learning foreign languages), foreign language teaching methods, translation theory and practice, cross-cultural communication, language testing and evaluation, language information technology (such as machine translation, corpus linguistics), etc., addressing problems in practical language applications.
